narr: Deep tropical moisture and a stalled boundary draped across the region worked together to bring wet and unsettled weather to South Florida. Repeated rounds of heavy rainfall over already saturated soils resulted in flooding across portions of Miami-Dade.
ev: Multiple reports from broadcast media of flooding southeast of Miami International Airport. Several vehicles appeared to be stalled on the roadside and temporarily unable to pass, along with the intersection of northwest 41st street and northwest 37th ave under water. Additionally, FDOT reported the two right lanes on SR-836 east beyond Lejeune Road were blocked due to the flooding. Public reported a rain gauge in the area had received 5 inches of rainfall in one hour.

A video retweeted by WPLG shows flooding in the Crossings neighborhood of West Kendall along SW 134th Avenue. There are several cars seen passing through, with others stranded along the side of the road. Several rain gauges in the area measured almost 5 inches of rain, most of which fell in about 2 hours between 1:30 PM and 3:30 PM.
